PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (58e-6, 30e-6, 68e-6),
    "Rf":      (200e3, 60e3, 1e6),
    "Cf":      (120e-15, 30e-15, 500e-15),
    "gtrim":   (1.0, 0.96, 1.04),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    # current budget: total supply = iref + Itail, keep <= 140 uW with margin
    itail = min(p["Itail"], 138e-6 / vdd - iref - 1e-6)
    itail = max(itail, 5e-6)
    ih = itail / 2

    # input pair: inverting input = output-side device (M2)
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = 0.9 - m_in.vgs
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.45, vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    vtail = 0.9 - m_in.vgs
    # PMOS mirror load
    m_p = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ih, vds=0.9)
    # tail and reference mirror (same L, gm/Id)
    Lt, gt = 1.0, 10.0
    m_t = lut.size("n", gt, Lt, itail, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    m_r = lut.size("n", gt, Lt, iref, vds=0.6)

    # open-loop gain with feedback loading
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.1571, 0.01797
    k1, k2 = g1t, g2t
    for _ in range(6):
        R1 = Rf / k1; R2 = Rf / k2
        Rp = 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2)
        gl = m_in.gds + m_p.gds + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp)
        A = m_in.gm / gl
        corr = 1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A
        k1 = g1t * corr * p["gtrim"]
        k2 = g2t * corr * p["gtrim"]
    R1 = Rf / k1; R2 = Rf / k2
    Cf = p["Cf"]; C1 = k1 * Cf; C2 = k2 * Cf

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_r)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_t)
    # diff pair: M1 gate = vcm (non-inverting), M2 gate = vn (inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "xd", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m_p)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m_p)
    # summer network (R with matched C for flat beta)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1); n.C("C1", "vin1", "vn", C1)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vn", R2); n.C("C2", "vin2", "vn", C2)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf); n.C("CF", "vn", "vout", Cf)

    # predictions
    a1 = -k1 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    a2 = -k2 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    cin = m_in.cgg
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cser = Cf * (C1 + C2 + cin) / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cout = cl + cser + m_in.cdd + m_p.cdd
    gbw = m_in.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    fp2 = m_p.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m_p.cgg + m_in.cdd))
    bw_raw = gbw * beta_hf
    bw = bw_raw / math.sqrt(1.0 + (bw_raw / fp2) ** 2)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(bw_raw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(bw_raw / (2 * fp2)))
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw, "power": power,
               "vout_offset": 0.0, "A_ol_db": db(A), "pm_deg": pm,
               "fp2": fp2, "vtail": vtail}
